items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:10:1
items.html: It selected from the Nekudot of SAG, in which the breaking had occurred, whatever it could select from them: This selection begins from the second Rosh of Nekudim, which is the Keter of Nekudim. But the first Rosh of Nekudim, which stands above the Tabur, did not join with this new MA, since there was no breaking in it at all, because the screen stands below it, and the coarseness in the screen cannot blemish above the place of its own existence, as above in parts 6 and 7. And this will yet be explained further along.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:10:2
items.html: And SAG became the female aspect: The intention is not upon the SAG of AK, but only upon the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, which the ARI calls by the name SAG, since their vessels are from the aspect of the nine lower ones of SAG, which are called the Nekudot of SAG. As above, page 463, the passage beginning “The kings,” study it there well.
